info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Partner Authentication-spec
info.description: The Partner Authentication API facilitates secure and seamless authentication for partnering applications. By integrating with this API, businesses can manage authentication tokens for their partners, ensuring secure transactions and data exchanges. This API supports scenarios where third-party partners need to authenticate to access resources. Typical consumers include partner businesses integrating their systems with yours for access to shared services or data.

post.description: This endpoint allows partner users to authenticate by providing their credentials. Upon successful authentication, a token will be generated for further API usage.

requestBody.description: The request body for authenticating a partner. It must contain valid credentials for the authentication process.
